login.title: Login
login.subtitle: Owners and personnel sign in to their pharmacy workspace.

registerOwner.title: Register your company
registerOwner.subtitle: Submit your details. A platform admin will review the company before you can sign in.
registerOwner.success: Your request was received. An admin will review it, then you will get an email and can sign in with the password you chose.

registrationPending.title: Waiting for approval
registrationPending.subtitle: Your company registration is with a platform admin.
registrationPending.body: You will receive an email when your company is approved. After that you can sign in with the password you chose.

forgotPassword.title: Reset password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.success: If an account exists for that email, reset instructions are on the way. Check your inbox.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Enter and confirm your new password to finish resetting your account.
resetPassword.invalidLink: This reset link is missing or has expired.

acceptInvite.title: Accept invite
acceptInvite.subtitle: Owners and personnel join a pharmacy workspace by invitation.
acceptInvite.info: Invite links are issued by platform admins and workspace owners through trusted Edge Functions.

supabase.missing: Add Supabase environment values to enable live authentication.
